headline: Quiet day: Google in talks to join Pentagon's Golden Dome programme
body: A quiet Saturday. Bloomberg reported Google is in talks with the Pentagon to help secure data for the $185 billion Golden Dome missile-defense programme, which plans heavy use of AI and autonomy, lifting Catastrophic Risk by 0.14. Self-Destruction rose slightly. Successors stayed the leading family. Horizon Balance slipped to -17.59 from -17.49.
